description: Reference-based feature illustrations for the README. Generated demo scenes, not native screenshots or runtime evidence.
generator: Built-in image_gen tool, using the landing-page image as a visual reference for every initial generation.
prompt_assembly: Concatenate shared_prompt, two newlines, and scene_prompt. Apply any edit_prompts to that generated image in order.
shared_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: a detailed documentation illustration of Automexia Terminal, based directly on the supplied landing-page image.
INPUT IMAGE ROLE: visual reference and style/geometry authority, NOT an image to reproduce unchanged. This must look like a feature-focused view of THE EXACT SAME APPLICATION shown in the reference. Closely preserve its recognizable cobalt/violet angular Automexia logo in the titlebar, understated native Windows titlebar, thin blue-gray strokes, near-black navy background, cyan focus perimeter, compact narrow regular-weight monospace terminal typography, and especially its pastel POWERLINE ARROW-SHAPED prompt segments: pale cream Ubuntu with small Ubuntu glyph, lavender main with branch glyph, sky-blue local, light green demo with user glyph. Tags are small and join into a horizontal ribbon; NEVER large rectangular badges. Use lime-green dollar prompts and cyan repository-relative paths "./demo" only. No home directories, personal paths, account identifiers, real cluster names, domains, IP addresses or secrets.
Composition: 1696x944 landscape, flat screenshot-like application filling almost all of the canvas, as in the reference. Match the reference's density and proportions, 50–60 px titlebar, approximately 20–23 px monospace terminal text at this resolution, restrained details. No poster heading above the app, no oversized type, no photographic monitor, no website or browser chrome, no decorative floating diagrams. Do not invent a dashboard, sidebar, file explorer, editor, cloud connection manager, or extra product surfaces. Keep text sharply readable and every table column aligned. Use entirely fictional demo output. Preserve the source image's visual quality and stylistic identity; do not substitute generic blue button styling.
A slim dark annotation strip OUTSIDE and BELOW the application frame may occupy the bottom 70px; use three compact numbered explanatory labels specified in the scene. It is clearly a documentation annotation, never a native toolbar. The strip ends at the far bottom right with small muted legible "Illustration • demo data". No additional captions, slogans, badges, decorative logo watermark or giant logo inside the terminal.
The resulting image is a GENERATED ILLUSTRATION, not evidence of a native application run. Only show the documented terminal features described next.

edit_prompts: Precise text correction in this supplied Automexia bordered-tables illustration: insert the flag '-a' after 'docker ps' in the first command, so it reads '$ docker ps -a --format \' followed by the unchanged format string on the next line. This is needed because the table includes an Exited container. Change only that command text, minimally shifting '--format' and the continuation slash right to make space. Preserve all other pixels, text, table rows, logo, dark styling, prompt ribbons, annotation strip, dimensions and frame.

images.scene_prompt:
Focus: SPLIT PANES AND FOCUS. Titlebar exact "Automexia — split panes". Match the original reference's one-large-left and three-stacked-right FOUR-PANE composition. No tabs in this view; tabs get their own illustration. Cyan perimeter on the big LEFT focused pane; other panes have quiet thin gray-blue dividers. Each pane's footer identifies "PANE 1/4 • LOCAL", etc., and shows UTF-8. Every pane uses the original pastel arrow-shaped Ubuntu/main/local/demo prompt ribbon at a scale that fits its width.
Left pane: path "./demo", "$ git status --short", two fictional rows " M src/main.rs" in amber and "?? tests/parser.rs" in cyan, then another prompt "$ ls" and a compact three-column file listing: cyan folder glyphs for "apps", "assets", "docs", "src", "tests", pale gear for "Cargo.toml", pale document icons for "README.md" and "LICENSE". No large logo watermark.
Top-right pane: "$ cargo test"; output "running 24 tests", "test parser ... ok", "test rendering ... ok", "test result: ok. 24 passed" in restrained green, then idle "$".
Middle-right pane: "$ docker ps"; small bordered two-column table NAME and STATUS, rows "api | Up 12 minutes (healthy)", "cache | Up 8 minutes (healthy)", each muted green row.
Bottom-right pane: "$ tail -n 3 demo.log"; three timestamped lines "12:04:10 INFO  server listening" cyan INFO, "12:04:11 WARN  retry scheduled" amber WARN, "12:04:12 ERROR upstream timeout" red ERROR. This is ordinary displayed log output, no actual remote connection.
Keep native terminal density, crisp 20px-ish regular text, thin pane boundaries, no oversized card gaps. Bottom external annotations: "1  Independent shell sessions" / "2  Cyan border marks keyboard focus" / "3  Resize the pane dividers".

Focus: TWO LEVELS OF TABS. Titlebar exact "Automexia — tabs". Closely match the supplied app's colors, chrome, logo and text. Add a restrained global navigation strip under the titlebar: dark navy rectangular tab "Development" active with thin cyan edge/underline, inactive "Operations" and "Assets", then small "+"; white regular monospace tab text. No bright blue filled buttons and no oversized tabs.
Below global strip are TWO equal side-by-side terminal panes, thin blue divider. Each pane has its OWN clearly inset smaller tab strip: left pane "Shell" active, "Tests" inactive and small "+"; right pane "Logs" active, "Build" inactive and small "+". This must unmistakably show local tabs inside each pane below the global strip. Left pane has cyan focus border, right inactive border.
Left active Shell uses original powerline ribbon Ubuntu/main/local/demo, path "./demo", "$ git status", output "On branch main" and "nothing to commit, working tree clean", then "$ ls" with cyan folder glyphs "src  tests  assets" and pale file glyphs "Cargo.toml  README.md"; next idle prompt. Right Logs tab uses a smaller original powerline ribbon Ubuntu/main/local/demo, path "./demo", "$ tail -f demo.log" and six tasteful fictional time-stamped lines: "12:04:10 INFO  server listening", "12:04:11 INFO  request complete", "12:04:12 WARN  retry scheduled", "12:04:13 INFO  retry complete", "12:04:14 INFO  worker ready", "12:04:15 INFO  queue drained". cyan INFO and amber WARN. Pane footers "PANE 1/2 • LOCAL" and "PANE 2/2 • LOCAL".
Use small circled markers placed in explanatory margins, not floating native buttons: "1" next to global strip; "2" next to left local strip; "3" next to right local strip. Bottom external annotations: "1  Global tabs select the workspace" / "2  Local tabs switch one pane" / "3  Other panes keep their sessions".

Focus: LOCAL IMAGE QUICK LOOK. Titlebar exact "Automexia — image preview". A single full-width terminal pane, cyan focus outline. Original powerline ribbon with Ubuntu/main/local/demo. Cyan path "./demo/assets". Lime "$ ls". Under it a neat terminal file listing with small violet image glyphs and filenames "landscape.png", "forest.jpg", "diagram.webp", "icon.png"; cyan folder glyph "screenshots"; pale document glyph "README.md". The row "landscape.png" is selected with a flat narrow dark-blue selection behind its text, just like the bottom-right pane in the supplied image, not an oversized UI tile.
On the right side INSIDE this terminal pane, show a large PINNED PREVIEW overlay card styled exactly like the original small image preview: thin blue-gray border, dark header text "landscape.png" left and "Esc to close" right; line of subtle metadata "1200 × 800 • PNG"; then a striking 3:2 mountain-lake photo with dark pine trees, snow-capped mountains, sunset light reflected in the lake, visually akin to the reference. Image contained within card, with no distortion or bleed. The card overlays terminal area, never creates a permanent browser/file explorer or splits the terminal. It fits the pane and leaves file list visible on the left. Under the selected path on left show compact documentary key hints with normal monospaced text, separated from command output: "Ctrl+Alt+I", "Preview selected image", and farther down "← / →  Previous / next", "Esc    Close preview". Clearly explanatory text in this generated scene. Pane footer "PANE 1/1 • LOCAL" left; "UTF-8 | LF" right.
Bottom external annotations: "1  Hover a path for quick look" / "2  Click or use the keyboard to pin" / "3  Arrow keys browse visible images".

edit_prompts: Precise wording correction only. In the supplied Automexia file-icons documentation illustration, replace the bottom annotation next to the circled 3, currently 'Native pipeline objects stay intact', with exactly 'Pipelines keep their original data'. This wording applies to both byte-stream and object-based shells. Preserve everything else unchanged: all filenames, icons, colored text, logo, prompt ribbon shapes, titlebar, terminal UI, selected parser.rs, callouts 1 and 2, Illustration footer, dark background and image dimensions.
images.scene_prompt:
Focus: FILE AND FOLDER ICONS AND COLORS. Titlebar exact "Automexia — file icons". One terminal pane with cyan thin focus border, original pastel Ubuntu/main/local/demo powerline prompt. Cyan "./demo". Lime "$ ls". Show a natural three-column terminal listing like the reference's lower-left pane, NOT a sidebar, file explorer, grid of tiles or a bordered table. All entries align to the terminal grid, modest 24px text. First column: small cyan FOLDER icons followed by cyan "apps", "assets", "docs", "src", "tests". Second column: small orange source-code glyph and "main.rs"; blue source-code glyph and "app.ts"; yellow braces glyph and "package.json"; muted cream gear glyph and "Cargo.toml"; pale document glyph and "README.md". Third column: violet image glyph and "landscape.png"; violet image glyph and "icon.webp"; amber archive glyph and "assets.zip"; pale plain document glyph and "LICENSE"; pale log-document glyph and "demo.log". Preserve understated Nerd Font-like single-cell glyph scale and consistent monospace text baseline, not huge file illustrations. Use colors for meaningful type distinctions; plaintext names remain fully readable.
Below, repeat original prompt ribbon, cyan "./demo/src", "$ ls", compact second listing with orange code glyphs "main.rs  parser.rs  renderer.rs" and cyan folder glyph "widgets". Finish idle green dollar and cursor. Include a subtle selection highlight across one filename only, so ordinary terminal interaction is visible. Pane footer "PANE 1/1 • LOCAL" and "UTF-8 | LF".
Bottom external annotations: "1  Cyan folders stand out" / "2  Distinct glyphs identify file types" / "3  Native pipeline objects stay intact".

Focus: KUBERNETES FULL-ROW STATUS HIGHLIGHTING. Titlebar exact "Automexia — Kubernetes colors". One full-width terminal pane with a thin cyan focus outline. Original pastel powerline ribbon Ubuntu/main/local/demo/K8s, with small Kubernetes wheel glyph. Path "./demo". Lime dollar then exact "$ kubectl get pods -n demo". Fill most of pane width with a bordered native terminal table like the original upper-right pane, thin blue-gray grid, neutral header. Exact headings "NAME", "READY", "STATUS", "RESTARTS", "AGE". Five aligned fictional rows:
"api-demo" | "1/1" | "Running" | "0" | "12m"
"worker-demo" | "0/1" | "Running" | "0" | "2m"
"queue-demo" | "0/1" | "Pending" | "0" | "45s"
"job-demo" | "0/1" | "Completed" | "0" | "8m"
"cache-demo" | "0/1" | "CrashLoopBackOff" | "3" | "4m"
CRITICAL: every text cell AND subtly tinted BACKGROUND across the WHOLE row use the semantic status color, just like the supplied screenshot. Row api-demo fully GREEN with dark green background. Both worker-demo and queue-demo fully AMBER with dark amber background: worker's Running word MUST be amber, not green, because it is 0/1 ready. job-demo fully CYAN with dark cyan background; its 0/1 must also be cyan. cache-demo fully RED with dark red background. Keep colors readable and backgrounds restrained.
Below table show another original powerline prompt and "$ kubectl logs api-demo -n demo --tail=3", then three plain unboxed log rows "12:04:10 INFO  server listening", "12:04:11 WARN  retry scheduled", "12:04:12 ERROR upstream timeout". Color the severity and message cyan, amber and red respectively, as in the reference. This demonstrates status presentation and logs without implying remote provider UI. Pane footer "PANE 1/1 • LOCAL", "UTF-8 | LF".
Bottom external annotations: "1  Readiness and status both matter" / "2  Green ready · Amber waiting · Cyan completed · Red failure" / "3  A successful query can show unhealthy pods".
